entities.summary: Tzu-Wei Lin is a Taiwanese professional baseball infielder for the Rakuten Monkeys of the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL). He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Boston Red Sox and Minnesota Twins.
